verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing says it integrates with external CI services like Drone, Woodpecker and Jenkins, and community users report running Gitea + Drone successfully. However, nothing in the pack documents commit or pull-request status checks, or a status API, for reporting those builds. missing for 10: documented commit status/checks API, display of external CI status on commits and pull requests, merge gating on status checks, hands-on corroboration of status reporting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see builds from external CI services reported as status checks on commits and pull requests

citations.quote: Improve workflows with integrations like GitHub Actions, Drone, Woodpecker, Argo CD, and Jenkins, among others.
Has used Gitea + Drone for several years and couldn't be happier
